title: A Current for the Provision
author: Orsen Dunmore
blurb: Xanthe Amberdale, a storm chaser who owes money to dangerous optimists, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. But when a government survey team vanishes, leaving gear and no tracks, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source before the dry season ends.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
